message.content:
I kept the copy constructor as a pure member-initializer list so the compiler emits a single base-class copy plus coalesced stores for the four trivial members, avoiding any redundant intermediate work.
```cpp
Field::Field(const Field &field)
    : FieldBase(field)
    , profile(field.profile)
    , profileIndex(field.profileIndex)
    , type(field.type)
    , isFieldExpanded(field.isFieldExpanded)
{
}
```
